placement_review.evidence: The mill mark remains east of the main north-south road in the stream-bend district, above the southern road junction. The modern road and drainage support broad locality, but the prediction lies east of the modern brook whereas the source mark is on its western side. Retain that bank disagreement without snapping or claiming an exact mill footprint.
